name: Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme for Backward Classes- Haryana
benefit:
1. Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹10,00,000/- are provided to artisans and handicraft persons from backward classes to preserve traditional arts and crafts.
   1. The scheme also offers training to upgrade their skills with the latest technological inputs, such as the use of computers, CAD, etc.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should be an artisan or a craftsperson.
   1. The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years old.
   1. The applicant should belong to the backward class category.
   1. The applicant&#39;s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/- in rural and urban areas.
